summary: Enhance your data flow management skills with our comprehensive Apache NiFi Training Course. Learn to automate and streamline data processes effectively.
lede: Apache NiFi data-flow management covers configuring pipelines that ingest, route, transform, and monitor streaming data. It is intended for data engineers, integration architects, administrators, and ETL developers who need to move data continuously between systems. Learners practice dynamic routing and record-based JSON and CSV transformations, secure flows with SSL/TLS and access policies, and use provenance tools to trace and replay data.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive 10-day program is engineered for technical professionals responsible for designing, managing, and securing enterprise data logistics.
modules: Apache NiFi Architecture and Core Components
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of data engineering concepts and basic familiarity with Linux command-line operations. Prior experience with data formats such as JSON, CSV, or XML is highly recommended. Basic knowledge of SQL and general networking concepts (IP addresses, ports, firewalls) will be beneficial for the database integration and clustering modules. No prior experience with Apache NiFi is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
